# [pytorch compile] Incorrect result when `requires_grad` changes

<!-- DRAFT generated by tcc. Review every section before filing (plan 18.6). -->

## Summary
The compiled execution is inconsistent with Python eager execution when `requires_grad` changes from `{'arg': 0, 'value': True}` to `(base)`.
all pre-Inductor layers agree and only Inductor differs: lowering / code generation
This test was generated because the static analysis found: requires_grad changes the traced graph regardless of source (factor `args.requires_grad`, oracles ['value', 'metadata', 'gradient']).

## Environment
- Python: 3.14.7
- Framework: PyTorch 2.14.0+cpu
- Compiler backend: inductor
- Commit/version: 08187d9e0fba026dc8217405802ab5381dc88d90
- CUDA/ROCm: none (CPU)
- GPU: cpu
- OS: Windows 11
- Triton: None

## Minimal Reproducer

```python
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)

def opinfo_std_mean_unbiased_397(*args):
    return torch.std_mean(*args, True)

args = (torch.randn(0, 1).requires_grad_(True),)

eager = opinfo_std_mean_unbiased_397(*args)
torch._dynamo.reset()
compiled = torch.compile(opinfo_std_mean_unbiased_397, backend='inductor')(*args)
print('eager   :', eager)
print('compiled:', compiled)
```

## Expected Behavior

Eager/reference result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [nan]
[1] [nan]
```

## Actual Behavior

Compiled result:

```text
structure: P[T,T]
[0] [nan]
[1] [0]
```

## Trigger Condition

Changed semantic factor:

```text
requires_grad: {'arg': 0, 'value': True} -> (base)
```

Controlled factors:

```text
shape / dtype / stride / device / compile flags: unchanged
```

Execution sequence:

```text
E0_eager: ok
E1_dynamo_eager: ok
E2_aot_eager: ok
E3_inductor: ok
```

A float64 reference was computed; numeric findings are reported only when the compiled error against that reference exceeds the eager error by more than the configured multiplier.
